method.method_draft: First describe the image as a space docking scene over Earth. Then read the text date as 2012年6月18日 and the candidate cities as 哈尔滨、北京、广州、上海. Since June 18 is near the summer solstice in the Northern Hemisphere, compare the cities by latitude: 哈尔滨 is the northernmost, followed by 北京, 上海, 广州. Therefore the city with the longest daylight is 哈尔滨.
